summary: The Medusa-4 JavaScript map omits its final Lua moat row, reducing height from 21 to 20. C moves the full-height fragment to ystart=0 and uses rn2(21) for random locations; JavaScript uses the smaller frame and rn2(20). Restore that source row in the caller, preserving generic map and coordinate owners.
